# Misrep undefined-9319618

## Narrative

(SECRET/NOFORN)
(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) AT 0015Z, 1.4a TOOK OFF FROM AL DHAFRA (OMAM).

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) AT 0030Z, 1.4a HANDED OVER FROM THE LRE.

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) AT 0145Z, 1.4a RECEIVED A PROFESSIONAL GUARD CALL. SEE GUARD CALL LINE 1.

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) FROM 0150Z TO 2019Z, 1.4a COLLECTED SIGINT VIA AIRHANDLER.

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) AT 0155Z, 1.4a WAS ON STATION IN SRO TRACK IRISH SICKLE.

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) FROM 0155Z TO 1837Z, 1.4a CONDUCTED IMINT ISO OP SPARTAN SHIELD (OP 1.4a SEE ISR LINE 1.

(SECRET/NOFORN) AT 0241Z, 1.4a OBSERVED 1X UAP. SEE UAP LINE 1.

(SECRET/NOFORN) AT 0322Z, 1.4a OBSERVED 1X UAP. SEE UAP LINE 2.

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) AT 1837Z, 1.4a WAS CLEARED TO RTB.

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) AT 1912Z, 1.4a WAS OFF STATION.

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) AT 2019Z, 1.4a HANDED BACK TO THE LRE.

(SECRET/REL TO USA, FVEV) AT 2058Z, 1.4a LANDED AT OMAM. FMV WAS EXPLOITED BY DGS-2.

(SECRET/NOFORN)
